design: Independent holdout. 128 adjacent off/on order-pairs per map, each mode a fresh real-time engine launch. Odd repeats: dm2 then dm4, off then on. Even: dm4 then dm2, on then off. No pooled decision with prior cohorts. Same candidate/source/nav/CLI throughout. No seed or frame-time override.
primary: Native brief totals.goals * 60 / native duration_sec, on minus off within each adjacent order-pair. Each map must have its two-sided 90% paired Student-t CI strictly inside [-2,+2] goals per match-minute (TOST alpha .05, df127 critical 1.6569403435420642). Both maps must pass. Failure to pass is inconclusive unless the entire interval lies beyond a bound. Not a significance shortcut. No outcome-based exclusions or stopping.
timing: Common developer 1 / scratch1 591 BHVTIME probe. scratch4 0 disabled versus 590 batched diagnostics. Discard first full five-second timing window as before; weight remaining printed mean_ms by frames per match. On-minus-off 90% paired CI widened by +/-0.1 ms for format rounding must remain strictly within +/-1 ms on each map. Audit all complete windows including startup and >20/>50 ms tails separately; retain last partial-window limitation. No material excess >50 ms frames.
mechanism: Retain process CPU delta over the same 60 wall seconds and raw tape bytes. Report paired CPU difference and its descriptive 90% CI, per-map modes and output volume. Fresh randomised workload is not a per-print microbenchmark. Interpret with earlier equal-input replay/state-guard evidence. Goal equivalence plus cadence equivalence supports sampling noise as the explanation of the earlier goal deficit, while permitting measurable CPU cost. Persistent goal non-equivalence plus cadence slowdown is evidence for logging overhead; without that, do not invent a causal attribution.
secondary: Report native grabs, acquisitions, engages, stalls, frags, lava_deaths and freezes with descriptive 90% paired CIs, plus avg_speed and tail-frame counts. No separately powered broad gameplay equivalence claim. Completed goals are not touch instrumentation; goal selections and grab detours are not pickups.
validity: Every tape retained. No fixture may activate, native map must match, tick_class listen, native duration 58..64 s, valid BHVTIME and required diagnostic output. Any technical failure stops execution and preserves its orphan tape; investigate before a logged technical amendment/replacement. Never exclude for gameplay results. Hash all successful raw tapes and native receipts. Source/progs/nav/CLI plus protocol and runner/analysis hashes checked throughout.
stopping: Fixed 512 successful valid matches. No interim primary CI or acceptance look, sample expansion, or stopping on pass. A technical or user interruption may pause the fixed schedule; resume only missing scheduled cells with the same frozen registration. If incomplete, report pending, never equivalence. Original bounds stay unchanged even if final result remains inconclusive.

power.method: Normal paired differences with variance estimated only from prior 8-pair cohort. 500000 simulated sufficient-statistic draws, numpy PCG64 seed20261024. Planning model only, not guarantee under nonnormality, serial correlation or a true effect near a bound.

holds: No QC, perception, nav or gameplay changes. Stage candidate only in workspace engine/argus/progs.dat; restore shipped bytes on completion/interruption. No external installation.
